execution.runner_contract: New runner is derived transparently from pinned R232 runner with a full limited diff: new round/paths/own role ids; explicit plugin and finite env; diagnostic outcome semantics; trace sidecar validation. Preserve real subprocess group timeout/reap, independent stdout/stderr, exact JUnit identities, real case/resource indexing and resource caps. Do not execute the old runner or any collector as a hidden second command.
execution.source_capture: Within this single slot, before spawn save complete current 27-source snapshots/pins and applicable211 checks under R234; old physical originals may be referenced but not overwritten. Snapshot all R234 new source bytes/role/gate/argv/env. Hash all27+211 again after cleanup. This is part of the one command, not a new standalone baseline slot. No product import for this source proof.
execution.directories: Require absent new capture outputs and basetemp before reservation. Create only R234 output directories and the new basetemp; no removal of existing files. Original R232 temp/DB/raw are not inputs to pytest and must not change.
execution.outcome: Always preserve actual pytest exit, all JUnit tests/failures/errors/skips, cases, trace capture and resource records before computing a diagnostic verdict. Child0 or1 with exactly3 named cases can yield diagnostic_capture_complete only if capture/resource/source/cleanup checks pass. Child2+, timeout, collection mismatch, missing trace/case sidecar, bounds overflow or restoration failure is incomplete and STOP. Never assert that the three tests must fail with a particular message in order to save their evidence.
execution.classification: Even three passed tests mean only observed diagnostic outcomes; legal_RED=false, GREEN=false, product_acceptance=false. Original-exception acquisition may be complete while cause remains unknown. No assertions or failures are rewritten.
execution.resource_contract: Reuse frozen fixture's actual allocation/initialization/cleanup and worker/session/broker/heartbeat/clock observations, exact caps from R232, and separate constructed vs polled counts. Denominator comes only from this actual run, not old402 counts or three assumed4-resource fixtures. Validate cleanup, existing issuer/thread relations, methods/profile restoration, child reap/group status. Unobserved OS/network/native/model data remain null. Do not add synthetic cleanup records or close product objects from the trace plugin. Counts are the existing observer's actual observed denominator; do not claim that unassigned or partially initialized broker objects outside that observer's reach were exhaustively enumerated. Supplemental trace/thread records are separately labelled and cannot fabricate a missing resource close.
execution.capture: Full independent child stdout/stderr, JUnit, trace per-node, original case/resource per-node, aggregate resource summary, file/temp index including symlink metadata without following, invocation and result. Save actual launcher/tool object immediately before display. Outer tool streams unavailable remain null unless separately redirected. Runner stdout only scalar/path/hash summary <=6000 UTF8 bytes. No rendered-output JSON.parse.

schemas.gate_input_records: All exact immutable old raw/6DB/old roles/physicalbefore references are checked before and after. This round live mutable controls are excluded from this loop and guarded separately at known generations.
schemas.source_before: capture/before/source-index.json: sources27 fullbase64+physical_archive,protected211,history,controls fullbase64; in result source_before plus index_pin
schemas.result: Inherited R232 full result with source_before/source_after/traces/diagnostic_capture_complete; legal_RED/GREEN/product_acceptance alwaysfalse. A complete diagnostic wrapper exits0 for actual child0 or1; otherwise1. All raw saved before verdict.
schemas.trace_summary: records list with full raw data/pin/thread_correspondence; supplemental trace never supplies missing resource close
schemas.resource_summary: Unchanged frozen R223 fixture command_id and validator; no assumed allocation count, no supplemental exhaustive broker denominator claim.
schemas.outer_tool_return: Separate actual initial/completion full tool objects; independent tool streams null unless genuinely supplied; no rendered JSON parsing.

trace_scope.mechanism: A standalone pytest plugin loaded only in this new diagnostic child. A hookwrapper around pytest_runtest_protocol installs sys.settrace and threading.settrace for the duration of each exact node including setup/teardown, then restores the previously recorded callbacks in finally. Existing sys/threading profile callbacks are never installed, disabled or replaced by this plugin.
trace_scope.preflight: Plugin accepts only the three exact nodeids. Before fixtures allocate, require sys.gettrace() and threading.gettrace() both None; preserve their real values and fail closed if another trace is present. Do not compose unknown tracing tools. No settrace_all_threads, signals into product threads or dynamic attachment to prior threads.
trace_scope.identity: Match exact resolved co_filename, co_qualname and co_firstlineno from the four pinned declarations. This is an observation filter, never an authorization test. Record the actual observed code tuple; do not call a product function or construct an owner/session to resolve it.
trace_scope.line_meaning: For _serve only, record first occurrence of each selected line per actual frame. 657 means about to call open clock, 658 means it returned, 660 means execution advanced past the normal ready.set, 678 is the outer catch assignment line, 681/683 are finally/close locations. These are line events, not fabricated readiness, thread completion or permission claims. Do not inspect or change the clock/queue/event values.
trace_scope.events: Record nodeid, process id, Python/native thread identifiers, per-thread/event sequence, optional host monotonic_ns labelled diagnostic-only, code tuple, event line, frame/self identity only, actual exception type/module/message, its original traceback frame paths/names/lines, and bounded cause/context with suppress_context. Do not capture arbitrary locals, payloads, credentials or fabricate an exception.
trace_scope.expected_idle: Only queue.Empty occurring in exact OperationalLeaseSession._serve at line662 may be compressed into actual count plus first/last event identity. Preserve unexpected exception types/locations; no blanket suppression. Return events following exceptions are not interpreted as successful function completion.
trace_scope.passive: The callback never changes frame locals, return values, exceptions, tracing/profile state of product code, wait values or code objects. Buffer bounded primitive evidence in memory; no filesystem I/O, product calls or blocking waits in the callback. The sole extra stdlib introspection is the bounded startup_timeout_observation below. Protect observer bookkeeping without sharing product locks. Any callback serialization/cap/error marks capture incomplete; do not propagate an observer exception into the product or silently claim complete coverage.
trace_scope.restoration: Write each trace sidecar exclusively after test teardown, outside the callback. Finally restore prior sys/thread trace callbacks exactly and record actual equality. Track threads which emitted events and correlate existing real cleanup records; do not claim thread-wide callback restoration for any surviving thread. A live child/broker/heartbeat or profile/trace restoration mismatch makes capture incomplete.
trace_scope.timing_limit: Tracing adds overhead, including filtering calls and selected _serve line events. A changed failure, no reproduction or timing timeout is observation only. Do not infer a defect or repair solely from trace timing, increase wait caps, run an untraced comparison or retry.
trace_scope.startup_timeout_observation: Only on an exception event in the exact pinned OperationalLeaseSession.__init__ frame, additionally read that frame's existing self._startup_error, existing _ready.is_set() boolean and existing _broker thread ident/native_id. Do not construct/call another clock, retry initialization, join/wait a thread or call a product method. Preserve unavailable fields as null with a reason. Serialize an existing startup error with the same bounded original exception/cause/context rules. For that one actual broker ident only, sys._current_frames() may supply at most16 current f_back frame descriptors (filename/qualname/line), with no locals or source-file reads. Record this as a best-effort non-atomic stack, not proof of a lock deadlock or complete scheduling history. Do not iterate other threads' stacks. Discard all live frame/exception references after converting to primitives. If ident/frame is absent or no informative exception exists, report unknown; no follow-up sample or rerun.
